title: Earliest Herders of the Central Sahara (Tadrart Acacus Mountains, Libya): A Punctuated Model for the Emergence of Pastoralism in Africa
version: Journal of World Prehistory 34, 531–594, DOI 10.1007/s10963-021-09162-8. Issue year 2021, published online 4 January 2022.
lineage: Primary report on direct bones and regional synthesis. Publication preview allowed access to the abstract and figure captions.

passages.locator: Abstract and caption of early cattle and caprine distribution maps, panel b
passages.note: Directly dated stock bones anchor the Early Pastoral chronology. Takarkori is site 30 on the caprine map, at 8.4–8.1 ka cal BP.
